# TenderOS by jouleWise

> TenderOS is a bid workspace for renewable energy tenders in India (SECI, NHPC, NTPC, state utilities). It reads a tender and its amendments with every value tied to its document, page and quote; sizes solar, wind and battery plants against the tender's conditions with HiGHS optimisation; prices the bid for a target equity IRR through a 25-year financial model exported as a live Excel workbook; reviews the bid against the tender and recent awards; and produces the bid pack. It runs on the client's own infrastructure.

Key facts:
- Maker: jouleWise (https://www.joulewise.tech). Contact: sales@joulewise.com, https://www.joulewise.tech/contact
- Tender types: FDRE round-the-clock, assured peak supply, Contract for Difference (SECI CfD-I), standalone BESS, solar or wind with storage.
- Language models read documents and draft summaries only; a person confirms every value. Sizing, dispatch, the financial model and the bid review are deterministic code.
- Demo result on SECI CfD-I (RfS SECI/C&P/IPP/13/0002/26-27, 500 MW × 2 h, bids due 20 Nov 2026): 262 conditions with pages, 40 amendment changes quoted; for a 100 MW bid with competitive inputs the optimiser keeps 10 MWac of own solar and prices the strike at ₹8.32/kWh at a 13.0% equity IRR (minimum DSCR 1.20).

## Data
- [SECI auction results, CSV](https://tenderos.joulewise.tech/data/seci-results.csv): one row per bidder in eight SECI e-reverse auctions (May 2025 – Aug 2026), awarded or not, with bid MW, awarded MW and final tariff, and the SECI notice
- [SECI auction results, JSON](https://tenderos.joulewise.tech/data/seci-results.json)
- [Open SECI tenders, JSON](https://tenderos.joulewise.tech/data/seci-open-tenders.json): scanned 16 Nov 2026 from www.seci.co.in/tenders
- [CfD-I demo numbers, JSON](https://tenderos.joulewise.tech/data/cfd-demo.json): the optimiser scan, a day's dispatch, the Pool table, bid-review findings
